All tags

Tags never load in previews. Each one waits until a visitor accepts its category in Cookie consent.

Your own visits stay out of the reports.

Google Analytics 4

Visits, events and conversions in Google Analytics.

Looks like G-ABC123XYZ9.

Loads
After a visitor accepts analytics cookies. Never in previews.
Allows
  • www.googletagmanager.com
  • *.google-analytics.com
  • *.analytics.google.com

Google Tag Manager

Loads your Tag Manager container. Its tags from other hosts are blocked.

Looks like GTM-ABC123. Tags the container loads from other hosts are blocked by the page policy; add them as their own row here.

Loads
After a visitor accepts marketing cookies. Never in previews.
Allows
  • www.googletagmanager.com

Google Ads

Conversion tracking and remarketing for Google Ads.

Looks like AW-123456789.

Optional. Sends a form conversion to this label.

Loads
After a visitor accepts marketing cookies. Never in previews.
Allows
  • www.googletagmanager.com
  • www.googleadservices.com
  • googleads.g.doubleclick.net
  • www.google.com
  • *.doubleclick.net

Meta Pixel

Conversions and audiences for Facebook and Instagram ads.

A 15 or 16 digit number.

Loads
After a visitor accepts marketing cookies. Never in previews.
Allows
  • connect.facebook.net
  • www.facebook.com

Microsoft Clarity

Heatmaps and session recordings.

Looks like k1a2b3c4d5.

After a visitor accepts analytics cookies. Never in previews.
Allows
  • *.clarity.ms
  • c.bing.com
